column1: # F4-02, F4-03: where F4 accepts what ECMA-376's Transitional XSD refuses, because PowerPoint
# writes it. Read by validate.py, which makes each edit in a private copy of schemas/ooxml
# and stops if an edit does not apply exactly `count` times. schemas/ is never changed, and
# Strict is never relaxed. --no-allowances shows the result without any of this.
# Each allowance is as narrow as the evidence: it widens one attribute or one content
# model, and a seeded case in crates/casual-slide-ooxml/tests/corpus.rs
# (f4_allowance_*) shows it needed and shows the real error next to it still refused.
# Evidence is the 66 decks of fixtures/real/README.md, on 2026-11-07. The writer named is
# each file's app.xml, which is evidence and can be false. None of this shows PowerPoint
# requires the form, only that it writes it (PV-01).
# Columns, tab-separated: id, file in schemas/ooxml (or ms-extensions/ and its name), count,
# exact old text, new text
# (\n is a CRLF, as these files have), evidence, reason.
F4A-1
column6: 6 decks (z21157343 130000; z15052513 25000, 80000; sdk-presentation 115000; z17310490 100000; z20089741 80000), and LibreOffice's export; no deck wrote a percent string
column7: CT_TextBulletSizePercent names only the percent form, though the same XSD defines the union ST_TextBulletSize of percent and ST_TextBulletSizeDecimal for it. The union keeps both bounds, 25% to 400%, so 24999, 400001 and text stay refused

column1: F4A-7
column6: sdk-of16-01 writes cx:externalData cx:autoUpdate="0", and so does every cx: chart our generator copies from it
column7: MS-ODRAWXML's chartex schema leaves attributes unqualified, so its autoUpdate is the bare name; the deck from the Open XML SDK's test files writes it in the cx: namespace. Qualified is accepted in place of bare; a bare autoUpdate, and a value that is not a boolean, are now refused
